facts.statement: Transitive yield covers natural produce, results, investment income and revenue.
Yield covers surrender of control, reflexive surrender of oneself, submission and yielding a legislative floor.
Physical yielding includes bending, stretching or breaking under force.
Yield can mean give precedence, be inferior, or become succeeded by something else.
A pitcher may yield hits or runs.
Noun yield denotes a product or amount returned; it can also denote productive capacity.
Middle English derives from Old English gieldan, cognate with Old High German geltan, meaning pay.
COBUILD records surrender, replacement, US traffic precedence, physical movement, production, revenue and noun amount/financial return.
Yield takes direct objects for control and produce; yield to can introduce pressure or a successor; productive intransitive use also exists.
Pronunciation is /jiːld/; forms are yields, yielding and yielded.
Noun uses include chemical reaction yield and nuclear explosive energy.
Yield up occurs both for relinquishing control and furnishing produce.
Production examples include unexpected results and poor sound quality; a positive outcome is not required.
Surrender may be intransitive or transitive, optionally with up.
Yield to maturity discounts promised coupons and principal to the bond price; the standard calculation excludes investor taxes and brokerage costs.
Yielding is also an adjective meaning productive, physically flexible, or inclined to comply.
